response.sql: SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_alp_gpt_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(1.0 * l.ALP / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS x WHERE x.ID = p.ID AND x.`U-PRO` = '-') GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX) AS per_patient GROUP BY SEX
